Creative Portfolio

Hi, I'm Eyram

Designer, photographer and front-end developer. I turn ideas into visuals that communicate clearly and stay with people.

I've spent the last few years making matchday posters and campaign graphics for KeedBet, leading media for the Deep Love Concert, and shooting and designing for churches and community events across Ghana.

I studied Information Technology at Ghana Communication Technology University, so I'm as comfortable writing HTML, CSS and JavaScript as I am in Photoshop or Premiere Pro. Precision and deadlines matter to me as much as the look.
